products.title: Serabit El-Khadim Bedouin Camp & 4x4 Desert Safari Adventure
products.product_title: Serabit El-Khadim Bedouin Camp & 4x4 Desert Safari Adventure
products.short_description: Explore Serabit El-Khadim from Sharm El Sheikh, discover the Temple of Hathor and ancient turquoise mines, then enjoy Bedouin camping and stargazing under the Sinai stars.
products.product_description:
Discover the hidden beauty of Sinai on an unforgettable one-day adventure through the mountains, valleys, and ancient landscapes of Serabit El-Khadim. This experience combines an exciting 4x4 desert safari, ancient Egyptian history, mountain hiking, breathtaking scenery, and authentic Bedouin hospitality, taking you far away from the usual tourist routes.
Your adventure begins at approximately 9:00 AM at Abu Zenima Road, where you will meet your local team and board a 4x4 Jeep specially suited for the desert terrain. Leave the paved roads behind and begin an exciting journey through the rugged mountains, rocks, and valleys of Sinai. Enjoy the changing landscapes as you travel deeper into the desert, with spectacular views and opportunities to stop for photographs along the way.
At around 10:00 AM, arrive at Beit Barakat, a traditional Bedouin house and desert camp surrounded by the mountains of Sinai. Take a break from the journey and enjoy a delicious traditional Bedouin breakfast with freshly prepared Bedouin tea. Relax, meet your local hosts, and experience the peaceful atmosphere and warm hospitality of desert life before beginning the main adventure of the day.
Ancient Temple of Hathor
After breakfast, begin your journey toward the historic Temple of Hathor at Serabit El-Khadim.
The visit includes an approximately 45-minute hike through the mountains. Follow the ancient mountain paths as you climb toward the archaeological site, surrounded by spectacular desert scenery and panoramic views of the surrounding valleys and mountains.
At the summit, discover the ancient Temple of Hathor, one of the most fascinating archaeological sites in Sinai and a place closely associated with the ancient Egyptian turquoise-mining expeditions.
Spend approximately one hour exploring the temple and archaeological area with your guide. Discover the ancient remains, inscriptions, and traces of the activities that once took place in this remote mountain region. Standing among the ruins, surrounded by dramatic mountains and complete silence, offers a unique opportunity to experience ancient Egyptian history in its natural desert setting.
After completing your archaeological tour, begin your descent through the mountains and return to Beit Barakat.
Traditional Bedouin Lunch
After the hike, enjoy a traditional Bedouin lunch at approximately 2:00 PM at Beit Barakat. Relax, enjoy authentic local food, and take in the peaceful mountain surroundings before continuing your desert adventure.
4x4 Safari – Wadi Baba & Serabit El-Khadim
After lunch, get back into your 4x4 Jeep and continue exploring the remote landscapes of Sinai.
Travel through Wadi Baba, a spectacular desert valley surrounded by mountains and dramatic rock formations. Enjoy the scenery, take photographs, and experience the peaceful atmosphere of one of Sinai's remote valleys.

products.product_description:
Your private guide and driver will pick you up from your hotel in Cairo in the early morning and take you comfortably to Alexandria in a private, air-conditioned vehicle. This is a fully private and customizable experience. The sightseeing program is flexible and can be changed according to your interests, preferred pace, and available time. You can follow the suggested itinerary below or choose to visit other attractions in Alexandria based on your preferences.

The suggested sightseeing includes the Qaitbay Citadel, a historic 15th-century fortress built on the site traditionally associated with the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria. Continue to the Roman Amphitheatre of Kom El-Deka, an important archaeological site, and explore the fascinating Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, which combine Egyptian, Greek, and Roman architectural influences.

Bedouin culture, stargazing, and one of Egypt’s most iconic spiritual landmarks.

Choose between a Private or Shared experience and spend an incredible night in the heart of the Sinai mountains. This experience is perfect for travelers looking for more than a traditional sightseeing tour — it combines adventure, nature, culture, astronomy, history, and a truly memorable night in Sinai.

products.title: From Cairo: 4x4 Desert Safari, Waterfalls & Magic Lake
products.product_title: From Cairo: 4x4 Desert Safari, Waterfalls & Magic Lake
products.short_description: Escape Cairo for a full-day Fayoum adventure. Enjoy a thrilling 4x4 desert safari, visit Wadi El Rayan Waterfalls and Magic Lake, try sandboarding, and enjoy an authentic Egyptian countryside lunch.
products.product_description:
Escape the busy streets of Cairo and discover the natural beauty of Fayoum on a full-day adventure combining desert landscapes, exciting activities, local culture, and authentic Egyptian food.

Begin your experience with a comfortable pickup from your hotel in Cairo or Giza. Travel in an air-conditioned vehicle toward Fayoum Oasis, one of Egypt’s most beautiful natural destinations, where golden desert dunes meet peaceful lakes and dramatic rock formations.

Upon arrival, transfer to a 4x4 vehicle and begin an exciting desert safari across the sand dunes. Enjoy the changing landscapes as your experienced desert driver takes you through some of Fayoum’s most scenic areas.

Visit the Wadi El Rayan Protected Area and admire its famous waterfalls. All required entrance fees to the protected area are included, allowing you to enjoy the experience without unexpected additional charges.

Continue to the beautiful Magic Lake, surrounded by golden dunes and dramatic desert scenery. The lake is known for its changing colors throughout the day, depending on the sunlight and surrounding landscape.

Stop at Mudawara Mountain, one of Fayoum’s most impressive panoramic viewpoints. Take time to enjoy the scenery and capture memorable photographs overlooking the desert and nearby lakes.

Add more excitement to your adventure with a sandboarding experience on the soft desert dunes. No previous experience is required, making the activity suitable for beginners and adventure lovers.

After your desert activities, enjoy an authentic Egyptian countryside lunch prepared using traditional local cooking methods. Choose between slow-cooked chicken or slow-cooked duck, served with Egyptian rice, seasonal vegetables, fresh salads, traditional baladi bread, and local side dishes.

You may also personalize your experience with optional activities, including a horse-riding experience, a dune buggy ride, or an upgrade to a fresh seafood meal. Optional activities are subject to availability and can be selected during booking or arranged before the tour.

After lunch and some time to relax, travel back to Cairo or Giza with unforgettable memories and photographs from one of Egypt’s most beautiful natural destinations.

products.title: Hurghada: Luxor Valley of the Kings & Tutankhamun Tomb Trip
products.product_title: Hurghada: Luxor Valley of the Kings & Tutankhamun Tomb Trip
products.short_description: Discover ancient Luxor on a full-day tour. Visit the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, and Karnak Temple with a professional guide. Optional: Tutankhamun’s Tomb or the Tomb of Ramses V and VI
products.product_description:
Full-Day Trip from Hurghada to Luxor

The trip starts early in the morning with pickup from the hotel in Hurghada by a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle. Guests then travel through the desert road toward Luxor. During the journey, there is a short rest stop of approximately 30 minutes, where guests can use the bathroom or have a light drink before continuing the drive to Luxor.

Upon arrival in Luxor, the tour guide will be waiting for the guests according to the language selected during booking. The tour begins with a visit to Karnak Temple, one of the largest and most important temple complexes in ancient Egypt. Guests will enjoy a guided explanation of the temple’s history, its massive columns, sacred halls, and impressive ancient architecture.

After visiting Karnak Temple, guests continue to the West Bank of Luxor. There are two options for crossing: guests may either continue by bus, or choose to cross by boat for an additional optional fee. If the boat option is selected, guests can enjoy a pleasant Nile boat trip for approximately 30 minutes.

After that, guests head to a local restaurant for lunch, then continue the tour toward the Valley of the Kings. On the way, there is a stop at the Colossi of Memnon for approximately 15 minutes, giving guests time to take photos and learn some historical information about the site.

At the Valley of the Kings, the package includes entrance to 3 tombs from the tombs open for visits. Guests also have the option, depending on their preference or pre-booked selection, to enter Tutankhamun’s Tomb or the Tomb of Ramses V and VI for an additional optional fee.

After finishing the visit to the Valley of the Kings, the tour continues toward the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut. On the way, there is a rest stop of approximately 30 minutes at an alabaster or stone handicraft workshop, where guests are welcomed with a cold local drink. Guests will also have time to relax or use the bathroom.

The trip then continues to Hatshepsut Temple, a unique terraced temple set against the mountains and dedicated to one of the most famous queens in ancient Egyptian history.

At the end of the day, guests return comfortably to Hurghada by air-conditioned vehicle after enjoying a memorable day exploring the most important historical landmarks of Luxor.

Visit the iconic Temple of Queen Hatshepsut carved into the cliffs of Luxor
Explore the massive Karnak Temple complex with its towering columns

Optional entry to Tutankhamun’s Tomb or Ramses V & VI Tomb

Your journey starts late at night or very early in the morning, depending on your hotel location and the confirmed pickup schedule. Travel overnight to Cairo in an air-conditioned vehicle.
